100X Merry MONEY's prizes make it a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about three-quarters is in wins under $10,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Everything here about "100X Merry MONEY" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 17.
1918.headline: How the prize money is divided

1919.body:
"QUICK WINS" has 428,466 prizes of a free ticket still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50 prize, with 7,087 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything above about "QUICK WINS" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1919.headline: The prize table, line by line

1921.body:
"$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" has 327,867 prizes of a free ticket still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1921.headline: A close look at the prizes

1927.body:
"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" just reached Georgia stores with three top prizes of $400,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Every line of CASH SCRATCH FEVER's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1927.headline: A brand-new game to watch

1929.body:
"Cheers 2027" just went on sale in Georgia. The game has twelve full prize levels with seventeen top prizes of $20,027. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Everything above about "Cheers 2027" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1929.headline: A new game is here
